title: An attribute's name may be `Owner::Name`, resolved as the type `Owner::Name` is, and a malformed attribute is one error
scope:
the name of a named attribute, and how the parser recovers from a malformed `#[...]` group. What an
attribute name must resolve to stays [0046](0046.md)'s shape-typed alias, and retrieval stays
structural.
dependsOnText:
[0046](0046.md) (a named attribute's name is a shape-typed `type` alias),
[0190](0190.md) (a `type` alias is also a member of a class, interface or enum).

summary.headline: An attribute can name a `type` alias declared in an interface or class
summary.body:
`#[Page::Meta(title: "Home")]` names the alias `Meta` declared inside `Page`. It is resolved
the same way as the type `Page::Meta`. A mistake inside `#[...]` is reported once, and the
declaration after it is still read.
